title.value: European Master in Migration and Intercultural Relations (EMMIR)
title.evidence_quote: European Master in Migration and Intercultural Relations (EMMIR)

qualifications: Applicants for an Erasmus Mundus scholarship or a non-fee-paying self-funded place apply by 20 December 2026
Fee-paying self-funded applications remain open until 15 July 2027
description_short: EMMIR, an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in migration and intercultural relations, is accepting applications for Edition 14 (2027-2029). Scholarship and non-fee-paying place applications close 20 December 2026 at 23:59 CET; fee-paying self-funded applications stay open until 15 July 2027.
status_evidence: Official EMMIR post (search results): 'Applications for EMMIR Edition 14 are now open'; scholarship and non-fee-paying self-funded applications due 20 December 2026 at 23:59 CET
EMMIR Structure and Timing page (search results) also gives the 20 December 2026 deadline
uncertainties: Evidence seen through web-search results of the official page; the page itself could not be fetched from this environment

Source list (fellowshipsguide.com / mlscientist.com / vacancyedu.com) unreachable from this environment; opportunity found by web search for the category this source covers, then confirmed on the official domain
Evidence quotes are the wording shown in search results
